title: The platform's own Space page is titled "Frequency · Frequency" in search results

source.ref: Mega pass 2026-11-19 (backwards test: production crawl, title audit)

detail: Mega pass 2026-11-19. The crawl of production found /spaces/hq titled "Frequency · Frequency" and each of its tabs "<Tab> · Frequency · Frequency": the root Space is branded with the site name and the root layout's title template appends the site name again. Fix: spaceProfileMetadata returns an absolute title when the Space's brand is the site name, and its share-card title drops the duplicate suffix. Every other Space keeps the template unchanged (lib/spaces/profile-metadata-title.test.ts pins both).

verify.note: Fails on main (the platform Space title is the bare brand, so the template doubles it). Passes when it is absolute and other Spaces keep the suffix.
